title: Stop canonicalization from silently repairing invalid ShapeAxis values
description:
Council multi-round semantic-integrity review confirmed a contract contradiction in DefinitionCanonicalizer.CanonicalizeShape: the file states canonicalization is non-repairing, but invalid CapsuleAxis values are silently rewritten to ShapeAxis.Y. Directly malformed definitions can therefore serialize as a different definition instead of failing.

Scope: remove the repair behavior and replace it with a DomainException (or a clearly documented legacy-only normalization path if evidence proves one is required). Add a regression proving invalid enum values are rejected and valid legacy/default behavior remains unchanged. Coordinate with TSK-0094 utility/consolidation work and TSK-0093 malformed-definition validation; do not add another normalization layer.

Validation gate: focused canonicalizer/validator tests, round-trip regression coverage, runtime build, Unity execution.
